# Copilot instructions

The project's conventions, commands and rules are defined once in [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) at the repository root. Read and follow it for every task.

Additional context in this directory:

- [instructions/](instructions/): path-scoped rules applied automatically by `applyTo`
- [agents/](agents/): `architect` and `reviewer` custom agents
- [skills/](skills/): `clean-code` and `conventional-commit`
